title: File Preview
empty: No text content is available for preview.
unsupported: This file cannot be previewed or edited inline yet.
conflict: The file changed on disk. Reload before saving.
discardPrompt: This file has unsaved changes. Close anyway?
agentInstructionPlaceholder: Tell the agent how to change this selection...
agentAccessRequired: 이 파일은 에이전트에게 허용된 폴더 밖에 있습니다. 여기서 직접 편집할 수 있습니다. 에이전트 편집을 요청하려면 폴더를 소스에 추가하거나 설정에서 개방형 접근을 활성화하세요.
saveBeforeAgent: Save the current draft before asking the agent to edit the disk file.
selectionTooLarge: Large selection. The agent will re-read the file before locating it.
selectionMapFailed: That preview selection could not be mapped exactly. Select it in Edit or Split mode.
defaultAgentInstruction: Improve this passage without changing its intent.
quickRewriteInstruction: Rewrite the selected text to be clearer and more natural while preserving the original meaning.
quickShortenInstruction: Shorten the selected text while keeping the key information.
quickFixInstruction: Fix grammar, typos, and awkward wording in the selected text.
quickTranslateZhInstruction: Translate the selected text into natural, accurate Chinese.
